text: If you wish to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first invent the universe.
author: Carl Sagan
visual_brief: A precise engineering drawing showing orthographic views and a cross-section of a massive nested spherical apparatus, where concentric containment shells, dimensional callouts, and alignment axes focus down toward a single tiny crucible suspended at the absolute center. Directional arrows indicate the inward compression and flow of energy through successive tiers of shielding toward the central core.
alt: Engineering cross-section of concentric spherical shells focusing energy onto a tiny center.
